scientific.integrity: The determinantal equation and the five-collinear rank-drop stratum are taken from the cited primary literature. The transverse statement is derived from an exact rational witness: multi-Veronese rank 4, Hessian rank 3, a nonzero normal 3-by-3 minor equal to -576, and equality of the Hessian kernel with the nine-dimensional stratum tangent space. Openness then gives the stated generic result.
scientific.limitations: Generic only along the top-dimensional five-collinear components over C. No classification is asserted for component intersections, coincident-point strata, deeper rank drops, the full nonreduced singular scheme, or positive characteristic.

title: A transverse \(A_1\) stratum on the six-point conic determinant
